description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into PagerDuty incidents against a target service. Each row's key_column value becomes the incident's incident_key -- PagerDuty's server-side dedup mechanism, so upsert is idempotent by design.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one PagerDuty incident (upserted via key_column/incident_key).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata. No downstream data -- write side effect lands in PagerDuty.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Upstream column holding a stable unique key. Written to each incident's incident_key field -- PagerDuty's server-side dedup marker.

details_column.label: Details Column
details_column.description: Column holding the incident body/details (plain text).

urgency_column.label: Urgency Column
urgency_column.description: Column holding urgency ('high' or 'low'). Defaults to 'high' if unset.

status_column.label: Status Column
status_column.description: Column holding target status per row: 'triggered'/'acknowledged'/'resolved'.

key_prefix.label: Key Prefix
key_prefix.description: Prepended to each key_column value to form the PagerDuty incident_key.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows to process per run (safety cap).

name: PagerDuty Incident Upsert
